page.overview:
Who is Jaw Titan?

The was one of the Nine Titans with a ferociously powerful set of jaws and claws that were able to tear through almost anything. Due to its small size, it was known to be one of the fastest out of the Nine Titans.

Those who held the power of the Jaw Titan demonstrated significant amounts of speed and agility in their Titan form. They could even move fast enough to catch most of the other Nine Titans off guard. Though the Jaw Titan was relatively small and weak, its mobility excelled in terrain such as Titan Forests.

As its name implies, the Jaw Titan possessed incredible biting and crushing strength in its jaws and claws which could be used with devastating efficiency against both Titans and man-made structures. Its claws were strong enough to cause severe damage to armored opponents such as turrets and even the crystal shell created by the War Hammer Titan. The force of its jaws was shown to be strong enough to chew through the hardened Titan armor generated by Eren Yeager as well as the aforementioned crystal shell surrounding the War Hammer Titan, something not even the Attack Titan was able to achieve. Its powers manifested in different ways among Titans, with some like Ymir only having hardened teeth while Falco, Porco and Marcel had hardened, armored masks, jaw plating and hardened fingers that could withstand gunfire.

Due to the influence of the Beast Titan's spinal fluid taken from Zeke Yeager, Falco's Jaw Titan was able to take on several characteristics found in birds.
